item.title: Prep baseball roundup: Kramlich’s homer lifts Tam past TL
item.description: Tam High’s Cole Kramlich hit a three-run homer to highlight the Red-tailed Hawks’ 12-1 victory over Terra Linda on Friday. Kramlich’s blast came during the Hawks’ six-run fourth inning as they took a 9-1 lead.
